service.description:
Product/PLM document attachment, Case 1 (single product): a document that applies to exactly one real Product (e.g. its own CE certificate, its own datasheet) - NEVER call this for a document that covers an entire product family (see attach#ProductFamilyContentFromPath instead; the calling agent must have already asked the user which case applies, per the product-content-attachment skill).
Adapts the real mantle.product.ProductServices.create#ProductContent (mantle-usl, reused as-is for the entity-create step) to a source file that already exists on a local/shared filesystem path (e.g. the LibreChat upload bind mount) instead of a multipart FileItem - reads the bytes directly via ResourceFacade, same dbresource://mantle/content/product/... path convention as the real save#ProductContentFile.
Seventh reuse of math-model-run-tracking: not a pure calculation, but an action whose outcome (which document, on which product, when) is worth a MathModelRun history.

parameter.name: productId
parameter.description: The real mantle.product.Product this document belongs to.

parameter.name: sourceFilePath
parameter.description: The uploaded file's name as shown in the chat attachment (preferred), or an absolute path on the shared filesystem if actually known. Never file content/base64. If this is not a real, existing path, it is resolved by filename against the configured LibreChat uploads directory (cyber.librechat.uploads.root) - do not guess a path (e.g. a model provider's own sandbox path such as /mnt/data); just pass the plain filename the user attached.

service.description:
Product/PLM document attachment, Case 2 (product family): a document that applies to an entire family of real Products (e.g. one catalog covering several power ratings of the same contactor line) - NEVER call this for a document specific to one product (see attach#ProductContentFromPath instead; the calling agent must have already asked the user which case applies).
Finds an existing mantle.product.category.ProductCategory for the family by exact categoryName match; creates one on the fly if none exists (as part of this same call, not a separate manual step - the real mantle.product.category.ProductCategory entity, standard entity-auto create). Ensures a mantle.product.category.ProductCategoryMember row for every given productId (idempotent - skips products already members), so the family the document is being attached to is actually populated with its real products, not just an empty category. Then adapts the real mantle.product.ProductServices. create#ProductCategoryContent to a source file already on a local/shared filesystem path, same pattern as attach#ProductContentFromPath.
Eighth reuse of math-model-run-tracking.

parameter.name: sourceFilePath
parameter.description: The uploaded file's name as shown in the chat attachment (preferred), or an absolute path on the shared filesystem if actually known. Never file content/base64. If this is not a real, existing path, it is resolved by filename against the configured LibreChat uploads directory (cyber.librechat.uploads.root) - do not guess a path (e.g. a model provider's own sandbox path such as /mnt/data); just pass the plain filename the user attached.

parameter.name: productCategoryId
parameter.description: An existing family ProductCategory. Omit to search-or-create by name instead.

parameter.name: newCategoryName
parameter.description: Required if productCategoryId is omitted and no existing category matches - the real family name, e.g. "ABB MS132 Contactors".

parameter.name: productIds
parameter.description: The real Products that belong to this family - membership is ensured (created if missing) for every one of them.
